title: Routine deploy and what to verify after it
caption: .github/workflows/deploy.yml, deploy/scripts/deploy.sh, docs/mvp/deployment-single-vm.md §8–§9.

steps.title: Add new env variables first
steps.body: If the release's `deploy/env/*.env.example` gained a name, add it to `/etc/velexis/<app>.env` (empty is fine). `sudo bash /srv/velexis/current/deploy/scripts/check-vm.sh --only envfiles --templates <new release>/deploy/env` lists gaps and values still at `CHANGE_ME`.
steps.expect: No `env files lack variables` or `CHANGE_ME placeholders` refusal later.

steps.title: Run the workflow
steps.body: Run from `main` (or a `v*` tag), wait for build + e2e, approve.
steps.expect: Run green; the deploy log ends with `deploy <sha> done`.

steps.title: Read the deploy log
steps.expect: Lines for migrate platform/reference/tenants, report, restarts in order platform-worker, ota-worker, platform-api, ota-api, portal, platform-admin, ota-admin, then `Caddyfile reloaded` or `Caddy restarted` only if those changed.

steps.title: Check the migration report
steps.body: `sudo jq '{total, applied: (.applied|length), failed}' /var/log/velexis/migrate-<sha>.json` and `sudo -u postgres psql -d velexis -Atc "SELECT key, status, schema_version FROM platform.tenants ORDER BY schema_version"`.
steps.expect: `failed` is `[]`; every active tenant at the newest version. A non-empty `failed` with a green run means 10 % or fewer schemas failed (the deploy does not stop for that).

steps.title: Health
steps.expect: Every check `ok`; payment pages match the new release's inventory.
